item.title: No-fault divorces set to be introduced after vote
item.description: MAJOR family law reforms have won the unanimous backing of politicians, paving the way for the introduction of no-fault divorces. The Draft Marriage and Civil Partnership Law will replace the Matrimonial Causes Law from 1949 and is designed to bring the island up to date with modern practices used in other jurisdictions. item.description: PROPOSALS for a new Heritage Law, covering how objects and sites of archaeological significance will be reported, recorded, investigated and preserved, have been backed by the Assembly.
